SELECT
  d.chunk_type AS 内容类型,
  COUNT(d.id) AS 文档数量
FROM documents AS d
WHERE
  d.parse_status = 'COMPLETED'
  AND d.kb_id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM knowledge_bases
    WHERE
      org_id = 316 AND knowledge_bases.org_id = 316
  )
GROUP BY
  d.chunk_type
ORDER BY
  文档数量 DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS 知识库总行数
FROM knowledge_bases
WHERE
  knowledge_bases.org_id = 316
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  AVG(latency_ms) AS "平均检索耗时(毫秒)"
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE
  retrieval_logs.org_id = 316
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  SUM(cost) AS 模型调用总成本
FROM model_usage_daily
WHERE
  model_usage_daily.org_id = 316
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.chunk_type) AS 内容类型种类数
FROM documents AS d
WHERE
  d.kb_id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM knowledge_bases
    WHERE
      org_id = 316 AND knowledge_bases.org_id = 316
  )
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  o.id AS 组织ID,
  o.name AS 组织名称,
  COUNT(kb.id) FILTER(WHERE
    kb.status = 'active') AS 有效知识库数
FROM organizations AS o
LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases AS kb
  ON kb.org_id = o.id AND kb.org_id = 316
WHERE
  o.id = 316
GROUP BY
  o.id,
  o.name
ORDER BY
  有效知识库数 DESC
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  k.id AS 知识库ID,
  k.name AS 知识库名称,
  COUNT(d.id) AS 文档总数,
  COUNT(d.id) FILTER(WHERE
    d.parse_status = 'FAILED') AS 解析失败文档数,
  COUNT(d.id) FILTER(WHERE
    d.parse_status = 'FAILED') * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(d.id), 0) AS 解析失败率
FROM knowledge_bases AS k
LEFT JOIN documents AS d
  ON d.kb_id = k.id
  AND d.kb_id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM knowledge_bases
    WHERE
      org_id = 316 AND knowledge_bases.org_id = 316
  )
WHERE
  k.org_id = 316
GROUP BY
  k.id,
  k.name
ORDER BY
  解析失败率 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  SUM(cost) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT stat_date), 0) AS "日均成本"
FROM model_usage_daily
WHERE
  model_usage_daily.org_id = 316
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "空结果检索次数"
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE
  result_count = 0 AND retrieval_logs.org_id = 316
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    d.parse_status = 'COMPLETED') AS "已入库文档数"
FROM documents AS d
WHERE
  d.kb_id IN (
    SELECT
      id
    FROM knowledge_bases
    WHERE
      org_id = 316 AND knowledge_bases.org_id = 316
  )
LIMIT 500

outcomes.sql_final:
SELECT
  COUNT(id) AS 检索次数
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE
  created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 DAY'
  AND retrieval_logs.org_id = 316
LIMIT 500

SELECT
  strategy AS "检索策略",
  latency_ms AS "端到端耗时(毫秒)",
  query AS "用户原始查询",
  created_at AS "请求时间"
FROM retrieval_logs
WHERE
  retrieval_logs.org_id = 316
ORDER BY
  latency_ms DESC
LIMIT 1
